segments.en: Today I practise 计算机英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 训练、推理与幻觉 with a teammate. I use training data to talk about 训练数据，用来让模型学习规律的数据. I use model training to talk about 模型训练，用数据调整模型参数的过程. I use inference to talk about 推理，模型根据新输入生成结果的过程. I tell my teammate: Today I use training data, model training, and inference. At the end, I say: I can use training data clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 计算机英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 训练、推理与幻觉 with a teammate. I use hallucination to talk about 幻觉，模型生成看似合理但并不真实的内容. I use confidence level to talk about 置信程度，表示对结果把握大小的程度. I use verify the answer to talk about 核验答案，用可靠来源检查回答是否正确. I tell my teammate: Today I use hallucination, confidence level, and verify the answer. At the end, I say: I can use hallucination clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 日常交流英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 新闻和观点交流 with a teammate. I use I read that ... to talk about 我读到……. I use According to the report ... to talk about 根据这份报告……. I use What's your opinion? to talk about 你的看法是什么？. I tell my teammate: Today I use I read that ..., According to the report ..., and What's your opinion?. At the end, I say: I can use I read that ... clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 日常交流英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 新闻和观点交流 with a teammate. I use I agree with that point. to talk about 我同意那个观点。. I use I see it differently. to talk about 我的看法不同。. I use We need more information. to talk about 我们需要更多信息。. I tell my teammate: Today I use I agree with that point., I see it differently., and We need more information.. At the end, I say: I can use I agree with that point. clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise github 项目英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 引用来源和文档 with a teammate. I use link to documentation to talk about 链接到文档，提供官方说明页面的网址. I use cite a source to talk about 引用来源，说明事实或说法来自哪里. I use reference an issue to talk about 引用问题单，在文字中关联另一问题单. I tell my teammate: Today I use link to documentation, cite a source, and reference an issue. At the end, I say: I can use link to documentation clearly today.
